recoverySchedule.description: Chronological controlled horizon extension: first future merge captures old worker; additional merges enlarge pending horizon; old completion is rejected; complete authoritative replay and current completion commit composite state. Duplicate/conflict schedules are separate branches from the enlarged gap.

atomicity.description: Future-v2 controlled AD-7 lifecycle capture. Distinct ordered entry, work, completion CAS plans; erase also captures post-tombstone reference quarantine. Only entry advances generation. Every stage retains exact index and logical component contents. A stale entry plan is rejected after newer completion. No runtime provider implementation is claimed.

concurrentRecovery.description: Controlled capture v1: each staleAttempts storedBefore is an independent reset/fork from newerStored; storedAfter proves preservation. Current clearance and duplicate retry are a separate positive branch. Time is checked within each branch, not chronologically across distinct controls. Superseded-lease and stale-checkpoint branches independently isolate only the named fence with all other fences current and an unexpired lease.
